editorial:
Imagine you are a college senior invited to the ultimate Halloween party on a moving train. You board the ride with Alana and a bunch of friends, thinking it will be a night of drinking and dancing. The vibe starts off as a total blast, but things go south quickly when someone starts picking off the guests one by one. You get that classic slasher feel where the characters are trapped in a moving metal tube with a killer they cannot escape. It feels like a throwback to those old-school horror movies where you just want to yell at the screen for the characters to run the other way.

What really works here is how the tension builds as the passenger list gets shorter. While some of the acting is a bit stiff, the kills are creative and the pace stays quick so you never get bored. If you love movies where a group of friends is hunted in a tight space, you will have a great time. You should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a solid pick for a spooky weekend.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the killer is actually one of the students who felt betrayed by the group. After a final fight in the train cars, Alana manages to fight back and outsmart the murderer. The killer is eventually stopped just as the train reaches its destination. Most of the friends are dead, but the survivors step off the train, shaken and traumatized, while the police arrive to clean up the bloody mess.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic slasher movies and trapped-room thrillers.
